hero.title: Teams that stopped waiting on translations.
hero.lead: From fintech to developer tools, Lingrove customers ship every market on release day.

featured.title: From quarterly localization projects to same-day releases in 24 languages.
featured.summary: Corvane's checkout and dashboard ship weekly. Before Lingrove, German and Japanese lagged three sprints behind. Now every locale merges with the release branch.

featured.title: Documentation and product UI, finally speaking the same language.
featured.summary: Tessella unified product strings and docs under one glossary, eliminating terminology drift between the app and its documentation.

quotes.quote: Our reviewers finally see the screen they're translating. Rework dropped by more than half in the first month.
quotes.name: Daniel Okafor

quotes.quote: Security review took one call. The audit log and data residency answered every question our CISO had.
quotes.name: Priya Raman

quotes.quote: It behaves like the rest of our toolchain: branches, pull requests, CI checks. Engineers barely notice it's there.
quotes.name: Jonas Weber

quotes.quote: We added Korean and Arabic in the same quarter without hiring another coordinator.
quotes.name: Sofia Marchetti
